derivation: Hand-derived, never run. stratum_uv: u = (cell % side + jx) / side and v = (cell / side + jy) / side with side 2 for 4 cells and 3 for 9. rect_point: position + tangent (u - 0.5) w + bitangent (v - 0.5) h. sample_weight: cos at the receiver x cos at the light over max(r^2, 1e-4); row 1 has r = 2 and both cosines 1 (0.25); row 2 has r^2 = 8 and both cosines 1/sqrt(2) (0.0625); the others have a cosine of 0 or coincident points. temporal_blend: h + (c - h) 0.1 when usable, else c. depth_consistent: previous > 0 and |p - c| <= 0.05 c (0.4 <= 0.52 yes; 1 <= 0.55 no; previous 0 no; 0.5 <= 0.525 yes). bilateral_weight: Gaussian[tap] x exp(-|dt| / (0.02 max(c, 1e-4))) x max(n.m, 0)^8; tap 0 with dt 0.2 gives 0.03125 e^-1 = 0.011496233; normals at 30 degrees give 0.5^8 = 1/256, so 0.28125 / 256 = 0.0010986328; tap 7 has no weight. ratio_visibility: s / u clamped to [0, 1], with u <= 1e-6 giving 1. mask_slot: (slot / 4, slot % 4). history_slot: (slot / 2, (slot % 2) * 2). groups_for: min(limit, 8) div_ceil 2. raw_layers: max(groups_for, 2). cell_side: 3 for 9 cells, else 2.
